claims.text: A tag points at one image at a time; by default pushing a different image under an existing name:tag repoints the tag. Some repositories enable immutable tags (Docker Hub), which block this.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: Build best practices > Pin base image versions ('even if a publisher replaces the tag with a new image'); docker image push

claims.text: When an image reference has no tag, Docker defaults to the tag latest; latest does not mean newest, it is whatever image was last pushed under latest, and a repository may have no latest tag.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: docker image tag (TAG: if no tag is provided, Docker defaults to latest); docker image pull

claims.text: sdk:10.0 floats to each new 10.0 SDK release (feature band or patch) and to rebuilt images of a release; sdk:10.0.401 itself resolved to sha256:83e0db97... and later sha256:e70cdb7f... on 2026-10-03; aspnet:10.0 floats likewise.
claims.source_hint: dotnet-docker repo docs (tag policy); executed: docker buildx imagetools inspect mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 / :10.0.401 / :10.0.400

claims.text: docker run --rm mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 dotnet --version prints the SDK version of whichever image the machine pulled (10.0.401 on the author's machine), so machines that pulled sdk:10.0 at different times can print different versions.
claims.source_hint: executed on the author's machine (Docker 28.0.1): output 10.0.401

claims.text: An image digest is sha256: plus a hash of the image's content (manifest); a different image has a different digest, and docker pull name@sha256:... returns that image regardless of later tag changes.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: docker image pull (Pull an image by digest (immutable identifier)); Build best practices > pin to digest

claims.text: docker pull prints a line 'Digest: sha256:...' for the image it pulled.
Pinning a base image by digest guarantees the same image each build but opts out of automatic updates such as security fixes; the digest must be changed (by hand or by a tool) to receive them.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: Build best practices > Pin base image versions

claims.text: Pin by digest when the team reviews base image updates; follow the tag when it wants fixes on each rebuild.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: Build best practices > Pin base image versions (trade-off stated there)

claims.text: Dockerfile@stage-1 lines 5, 19: FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0 AS build, FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:10.0 AS final; no digest; a machine that pulls them again (new machine, or --pull) gets what the tags point to then.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1 DonHang.Api/Dockerfile:5-19; git grep '@sha256' stage-1

claims.text: docker-compose.yml@stage-1 lines 44-46: service web with image caddy:2.10.0 and container_name donhang-web.
Some publishers never move version tags like 2.10.0 and some repositories make tags immutable, but by default a registry allows the move; the name does not show which case applies.
claims.source_hint: Docker docs: Build best practices ('This publishing workflow is best practice... but it isn't enforced'); docker image push

claims.text: docker image ls --digests caddy shows the registry digest of the pulled image (caddy 2.10.0 sha256:133b5eb7...) in the DIGEST column.
docker pull caddy@sha256:<digest> on a machine that already has that image prints 'Status: Image is up to date for caddy@sha256:...'.
claims.source_hint: executed on the author's machine, Docker 28.0.1

claims.text: Pulling a repository by name with no tag fails when the repository has no latest tag (manifest unknown / not found).
claims.source_hint: executed: docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-api:latest -> manifest unknown; Docker docs: docker image pull

claims.text: Microsoft rebuilds and re-pushes .NET images under the same tags without a new .NET release, for example when the base OS image gets updates.
claims.source_hint: dotnet/dotnet-docker docs: Image Update Policy (images rebuilt after base image updates); observed sdk:10.0.401 two digests same day

claims.text: donhang-api:stage-1 was never pushed: no file at stage-1 runs docker push, and docker manifest inspect ghcr.io/duyan11110/donhang-api:stage-1 returns manifest unknown; so no registry holds a digest for it.
claims.source_hint: examples/don-hang @ stage-1 (git grep docker push); docker manifest inspect
